observation: The PMax search-category insight 'student loan hardship advice' received 40 impression(s) and 12 click(s) in the 2026-07-13-2026-07-19 period, and matches the configured irrelevant-topic category 'student loan'.
interpretation: This category label reads as outside the account's target audience. Cost impact cannot be stated — PMax search-category insights have no cost field, unlike Search's search_term_view.
recommendation: Add 'student loan hardship advice' to the account-level Performance Max negative keyword list (Settings > Account-level negative keywords), or a brand exclusion list if this is a competitor/brand name — PMax does not support ad-group or campaign-level EXACT-match negatives the way Search does.
estimated_impact: Not measurable — no cost data exists at this granularity for PMax search-category insights.
